recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further source changes would duplicate the current adherence.reason model or reintroduce obsolete MedicationUsage/statusReason terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-31950 was a Published Pharmacy change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to move MedicationUsage.statusReason under adherence, with the final resolution specifying adherence as a 0..1 backbone, adherence.code 1..1, and adherence.reason 0..1.
initial_application: Git commit 934e7819020c72ee6e3ba509ecb5445a1850f109, whose message includes 31950, removed MedicationUsage.statusReason, made MedicationUsage.adherence a BackboneElement, added MedicationUsage.adherence.code and MedicationUsage.adherence.reason, and updated an example to put a not-taking reason inside adherence.reason.
additional_context: FHIR-38682 later renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement while retaining the R5 status/adherence changes. The combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-32858 reconciliation that clarified MedicationStatement.adherence.reason wording and supports using adherence.code/adherence.reason for taking and not-taking scenarios.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/fhir.ini marks MedicationStatement active, the active StructureDefinition already defines MedicationStatement.adherence 0..1, adherence.code 1..1, and adherence.reason 0..1, and no current MedicationStatement.statusReason element exists in source/medicationstatement.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement while keeping the status/adherence model.
